mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a clear 78 degrees by City Hall. Tonight, we have a first quarter moon and a treat for space fans with an ISS sighting starting at 9:33 PM, traveling from over Verona High School toward Fitchburg, reaching halfway up the sky.

For city updates, tune into VHAT, our public access channel for government meetings and community news. Also, if you need to manage yard waste, you can register for the Food Scrap Stop program to drop off organic material at Badger Prairie County Park.
There is a busy lineup ahead including trivia at Hop Haus on Tuesday, the downtown farmer's market on Wednesday, and the free Concerts in the Park series this Thursday at Century School Park.
Looking at the weekly report, on July 16, a driver was arrested on an outstanding warrant after being pulled over for expired registration.
The Culver's flavor of the day is Chocolate Caramel Twist. The restaurant is currently closed but will open at 10 AM, and tomorrow you can look forward to the Mint Explosion.
